segments.text: So let's raise the big question.
Is Rahul Gandhi now going for broke with his SIR agitation?
Is SIR bringing on vote-chori, bringing all anti-BJP, anti-Modi forces together?
Does the SIR vote-chori issue really resonate with common citizens?
is the BJP's padayatra plan to take on opposition working on the ground.
Joining me now Pradeep Bhandari, the BJP's national spokesperson.
Advocate Pranab Dhawan is CJP spokesperson and Gurmehar Kaur of the Congress, its spokesperson joining me.
Gurmehar, let me come to you first because Rahul Gandhi in the video today says,
calling all those against Amit Shah, Narendra Modi, Gyanesh Kumar to come together.
So is this now about constitutional questions and the Election Commission or is this now straight a political march that targets Amit Shah and Narendra Modi as well?
Sir, thank you so much for having me on your show.
I actually want to start with something very simple.
The BJP today has a very, very simple problem tonight.
It is that it simply cannot answer the questions that are being asked by young people, so it is deciding to question patriotism instead.
And what we are doing, it is
Is it about the question that you're asking?
Is it about the election commission, or is it about Narendra Modi and Amit Shah?
Well, it is obviously about the election commission.
And of course, it's linked to Modi and Shah, because they are these two people, because of whom there are these SIR irregularities that are happening.
So when Rahul Gandhi says, don't worry about police or LATIs, come and save the democracy,
We must go and work and save the democracy as he says.
No, no.
So is it about saving democracy or is it about ousting Modi Shah?
Let's be clear.
Has this now become less about Gyanesh Kumar and more about Modi Shah?
So I think it's the same question about regime change.

When there are electoral discrepancies, when there are questions about the electoral process, when there are questions that the current government is involved in malpractice of the electoral process, then of course when there are very serious allegations that are being put on the government, then
In a situation like that, the question of whether that government should stay or not stay is 100% on the line.
And it starts with the impeachment of Ganesh Kumar, which is going to happen on the 1st of November, at least public impeachment.
You know, I want to bring in, therefore, Pradeep Bhandari.
Pradeep Bhandari.
The Congress is saying you cannot separate the two issues anymore.
There is Gyanesh Kumar as Chief Election Commissioner and the opposition is linking that to Narendra Modi and Amit Shah.
They are one according to the opposition.
That the CEC is batting for Modi Shah.
So when they call for Gyanesh Kumar to go, naturally they will also attack Mr. Modi and Amit Shah.
That's the opposition stand.
Your response.
Well first of all at the outset Rajdeep, I just want to show you and tell your viewers that Karnataka Congress has increased the price of milk by 8 rupees, 8 rupees specifically.
That's the biggest hit on the common man which the Karnataka government of the Congress party has done and this tells you how hypocritical Rahul Gandhi is.
But let me come to the issue.
Rajdeep, you've been doing journalism for more than three decades, if I'm not wrong.
And you are a very well-read man of the Indian Constitution.

And I want to ask you, and this is through you, I want your viewers to also be educated, that any decision on the election commissioner who is of the same parameter, particularly the CEC of the Supreme Court Judge, can only be done by the Indian Parliament, by two-thirds of members present and voting.
That is how it has to happen by both the Houses of the Parliament.
So if the Congress party is so confident about it, the Congress party should ask for a special session, get the numbers and do it.
Just a minute Mr. Pandari, they had the 50 MPs did sign which was the requisite number in March this year and yet the Chairman of the House didn't allow the impeachment to go through.
If the Speaker and the Chairman will not allow the impeachment of the Speaker inside Parliament, they want to now do it outside.
What's wrong with that?
They want to make a statement.
It's a way of making a political statement.
Let them make.
So you also admitted that it's a political statement.
The issue does not have substance because the issue is subjudice.
The Supreme Court is hearing the matter and the Supreme Court has given 10 days of notice to different parties.
So on your show in the opening, it has been admitted that they're trying to make a political statement.
It is nothing to do with democracy.
Now let's answer the political question, leave the democracy part aside.
Politically, the people of the country, Rajdeep Ji, are voting more than 90% in various elections, which means that they have the faith in the electoral process.
The constitutional morality will be decided by the Supreme Court, not by the BJP or the Congress.
And as of right now, the Supreme Court has not given a negative statement on the constitutional morality either of the SIR or any of the allegations which Rahul Gandhi is raising.
So what is this exactly?
This is nothing but Rahul Gandhi attempting to show himself as the leader of the opposition getting everybody along.
So last time you did not have the Aam Aadmi Party, you did not have the DMK backing.

And if Rahul Gandhi is saying that this is a march which should really everybody who is against Prime Minister Narendra Modi, so let's say hypothetically he gets 20-25 thousand people at Ram Leela, hypothetically, does it mean according to his logic then the entire country apart from 20-25 thousand people are backing Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
So my argument here is that nobody is buying what Rahul is saying.
This is why Rahul Gandhi is getting frustrated and time after time he is shifting goalposts.

For instance, if he has problem with SIR, Karnataka SIR got completed, 99 lakh deletions have happened which is one of the highest in the country and their own minister Satish Jharki Wohli is backing it.
So he should first sack Satish Yadgi Gole if this entire process is for SIR and is a political statement that he's trying to make.
So I believe that people are very wise.
You are also wise and this is why there are no takers of Rahul Gandhi except his anarchic lot, which are few thousands in nature.
Okay, Gurmeer, you want a quick response and then I'll go to Pranav of the Cockroach Janata Party.
You see, according to the BJP, 25,000 people, 50,000, 1 lakh gathering at Ram Leela Maidan is not India.
They're saying, is this an issue that is going to resonate with India?
25,000 Congress loyalists or India block loyalists is not India.
I think in a democratic country, the entire opposition does represent India.
All the MPs, they carry certain amount of votes.
Citizens have put their faith and their vote for these MPs.
And of course, they do represent India.
to meet this question of whether to politicize SIR, whether to politicize this demand for Gyanesh Kumar's resignation.

See, sir, when the electoral process, and I will say this again and again, when the electoral process is compromised, it is the duty of the opposition to bring forth all the evidence, to bring forth all the allegations, to bring all the opposition MPs and civil society members together and demand
and demand the resignation of the person responsible for it.
No, but your own ministers in Karnataka and Kerala, some of them have no problems with that same SIR exercise.
I mean, Rahul Gandhi is saying one thing in Delhi, Satish Jarchioli in Karnataka says that the SIR has been a valuable exercise in removing voters.
So, but there's this question of which voters and how many voters, and we will keep going back to those numbers.
For example, even if we, there is this constant conversation that the BJP keeps saying that we are going to detect, delete, and then deport voters, right?
However, they have only been able to find, let's say, around 700 foreign infiltrators, many of them from Nepal, but around 13 crore voters have been removed.
What I am focusing on and what we are focusing on is what is happening on a larger scale.
That there are 13 crore voters that have been deleted.
13 crore voters include, admittedly, also several who are dead, several who moved residents.
But yes, there are question marks over the number of voters.
I mean, for example, look at four votes in Trilokpuri.
I want to go back.
Yesterday, there was an exercise that happened where voter rolls were put out and people were asked to come and check.
There are 400.
actually around more than 400 people in simply four booths whose names were illegally cut.
They're standing there saying, look, here we are, and yet their names do not make it to the voter roll.
What does the BJP have to say about miscalculations like that?
Madam, I take your point, but you know, Pradeep Bhandari, you see, the BJP seems to paint anyone who protests against you as anarchic, anyone who protests against you as anti-national.
Gurmeer Kaur says, you know, where are the foreign infiltrators?
The BJP kept saying, or your leaders kept saying, Ghuspetia, Ghuspetia, foreigners are being weeded out.
The numbers actually are showing very few hundred so-called Ghuspetias are weeded out.
So the BJP also needs to recognize that people have the right to dissent, even if one eligible voter,
one Indian citizen who is eligible is left out, that's a problem.
So the BJP, why not, why not recognize the problem?
The election commission is making changes after if the SIR sub Changasi in the SIR, why are you making, why is the same election commission making those changes?
Rajdeep Ji, let us read that completely.
Not a single eligible voter should be allowed to vote.
At the same time, not a single ineligible voter should be allowed to vote.
So my argument and submission is A, why should 2.8 crore dead voters be allowed to vote and who are those individuals who are voting on the name of 2.8 crore dead voters?
Rajdeep Ji, you are living in Delhi.
Let's say you are from Mumbai hypothetically.
You cannot have vote in two places.
So why are 1 crore people who are duplicate and having two ID cards allowed to vote?
Why should 6.3 crore permanently shifted be allowed to vote?
Why should 3 crore absentee be allowed to vote?
The Indian constitution only gives right to Indian citizen above the age of 18 years to vote.
So at the same time not a single eligible should be left out to vote.
At the same time not a single ineligible should also be allowed to vote.
But let me come on this.
Let's not go with hearsay.
Are they not having faith in Abhishek Banu Singhbhi who is representing them in the Supreme Court?
They can submit all these evidences in the affidavit in front of the Supreme Court of India.
What are they trying to achieve from the street except anarchy and Rahul Gandhi's political statement?
I have no problem with dissent, Rajdeepji.
Rahul Gandhi could even protest, take a march till the Supreme Court of India.
Our issue is with statements like Neha Bora who spoke and get inspiration from Bangladesh.
Our issue is with statements like Vashanth Bhushan who said that revolution will happen from streets.
There is no problem with descend.
In fact, the cockroaches also were allowed to protest on the first hand.
But what was the outcome of it?
When the state trusted them, the outcome was patharbadi, the outcomes were more than 700 criminals infiltrating in it.
And this is why they had to sign a peace bond, which they were reluctant to sign.
So we have no problem with descend, but we have problem with anarchy, we have problem with violence and the state has legitimate right to check that.
Okay, I want to bring in Pranav.
No, no, one minute, ma'am.
I want to bring in Pranav of the Kokhrut Janata Party.
Pranav, you're hearing those statements being made by the BJP.
First of all, I want to ask you, are you all going to join this Ram Leela Maidan rally?
Rahul Gandhi is saying he wants everyone who believes that the constitution is under threat to join.
Will the Kokhrut Janata Party, the likes of Abhijit, Dipke, Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka also be part of this rally?
We strongly support the demand of the rally and the spirit of the rally, but let me just You support the spirit of the rally.
Will you join the rally?
We have already given a comprehensive statement on that.
I think beyond that needs to be said by a spokesperson.
No.
So why are you joining it?
No, I must ask you.
Why aren't you joining the rally?
If you believe that this is all about Raoul Gandhi saying today in his statement, he wants everyone who believes that the constitution to join.
We are an independent political pressure group.
We decide our strategies according to various decisions, and we are also a group which is spread out all over India.
We're not just a Delhi-based outfit.
We will take our decisions as they go along.
You have seen a statement from the founder president of the party.
for the steps to be taken.
But let me point out two very core hypocrisies of the BJP on this point.
BJP today disturbed the traders and businessmen of Chandni Chong.
They did a rally.
I don't want to know whether they took a 10 day permission for it, whether there was an economic impact assessment done, whether there was a notice given to the court about how much impact.
They did a padayatra.

Secondly, and this is the BJP which has come to power after movements like Ramzan Bhumi movement, and it is now criminalizing the very act of making issues political in a republic, we all have a right to political justice.
How can we not have politics about issues with the subjudice?
There is no rule of law known to law or the jurisprudence which say that if something is a matter pending in court, you cannot have politics about it.
In a republic, you are supposed to have politics.
Finally, the BJP's problem is that it wants to have a Dadakiri over
what is Indian and what is not Indian.
If people are going to India party rally, they are not Indian.
If people are eating meat during Navratri, they are not Indian.
If people are participating in CJP rallies and want to have jobs in UP, they are not Indian.
BJP needs to know that it has only gotten the license to govern India under the system of police.
political legitimacy run by legitimate elections.
And if it continues to run roughshod over our elections and compromise them and manipulate them, the youth of India and the people of India will not tolerate it.
The courts of India will also come down heavily on it.
So please don't try to hide behind the courts and the judicial process.
We have whole faith in the lawyers who represent us in courts, but that does not mean that we have mortgaged our political rights to advocate for justice.

I've heard you and you've spoken very strongly but Pradeep Bhandari you see it's interesting you're coming on the show and saying you have no problem with the right to dissent no problem with the right to protest you have a problem with those who call for violence and anarchy but you've got in Uttar Pradesh your Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath his government saying we won't give government jobs to those who protest
Are you essentially saying that the right to protest is unconstitutional?
You are going to delegitimize anyone who goes to protest.
So you've got the, you've got Rahul Gandhi inviting people to come and protest.
He's not saying that this is not supposedly a violent protest, but the BJP is immediately in Uttar Pradesh saying anyone who goes to these protests will not be given a government job.
How can you link the right to protest to a government job?
Rajdeepji, first of all, Constitution Article 19.1a has to be read with Constitutional Article 19.1b.
So let's not read 19 Article 19 in isolation or selectively.
Point number two, service rules of anybody who applies for a government job, please he or she, there is no political protest quote unquote.
Mr. Cockroach, I was not interrupting.
You relax.
You can speak in your time.
Number two, it is nothing to do with protest.
It is to do with political protest, which are anarchic in nature and any individual who wants to be a government servant, please read the civil services rule.
He or she need not be engaged in any political activity.
They need not have a political bias.
Now point number two.
And if you have a problem with it, the government order can be challenged in the court.
Now a very specific point.
Please, Rajdeepji, you tell me.
anything which is to do with the constitutionality of a matter which is illegal, legal, constitution not, it will not be decided through streets.
Can you tell me that tomorrow, let's say hypothetically they have 2 lakh people on the outside Ramli law, 200 people outside Ramli law.
How will it affect in terms of the arguments which are made in front of the court of law?
Because the matter which is decided in the court of law, in this case with Rahul Gandhi, says that the entire SIR exercise according to Rahul was illegal.
So this will be decided on the basis of the merit of the case.
It does not matter how much Bharti's antar-party mobilized or how much Congress mobilized.
That's politics.
So let us admit on your show that what cockroach and Congress is doing is not constitutional, not democratic.
It's politics.
Pradeep Bhandari, good argument, but the same thing was said about the Ram Janma Bhoomi movement.
That also was outside.
No, no.
You see, once you allow street protest, when you are in the opposition, you happily protested on the street.
Now, when they protest, you have a problem with it.
Quick answer and then I'll go to my other guest.
Quick answer.
No, no, Rajdeepji, Rajdeepji, I have no problem with protest till the time they do not back likes of Sharjeel Imam who wants chicken neck to be out of the country.
I have no problem with the protest till the time Mr. Prashant Bhushan does not give clarion calls of streets anarchy hogi aur sadak pe khoon baiga.
I have no problem with the protest till the time they do not take inspiration from Bangladesh.
I have no problem with the protest till the time they do not say ki sansad ukhaar fek denge.
If we had problem with the protest, people would not be sitting in Jantar Mantar for more than 20 years.
So please you have to respect that the government is given the right to protest.
We are not Indira Gandhi who would impose emergency.
We give people right to opinion, but it cannot be at the cost of anarchy.
Okay, let me ask Gurmehar Kaur and Pranab to intervene.
Gurmehar to you, is there an end game?
You know, Rahul Gandhi, it seems is going for broke.
Day after day he wants the eyeballs, the narrative.
But what is the end game?
There is the matter as Pradeep points out is being heard in the court.
Why not wait till the Supreme Court decides on it?
So I'm actually going to start with the comments that have been made about anarchy.

I feel like Prateep Bhandari here very skillfully, and I must congratulate him on his skill, skillfully building a picture where there's actual anarchy that is happening out on the streets, whereas it's not.
It's factually incorrect.
What's happening on the streets, the young people are coming out, speaking up, and what the BJP has done, it has turned Delhi into a garrison.

where the state police and the state resources were used to detain, to hurt protesting students and put them brutally into buses, the entire country has seen what has happened and who the anarchic forces were.
What is happening on November 1?
November 1 there is the Vot Pachav Deshpatav rally that has gotten the police permission.
This NOC was granted on October 17th.
And yet, you know, we are again and again hearing things about anarchy, foreign toolkit,
regime change.
Sir, this is the language that the British used to use against Mahatma Gandhi.
You know your Edwin Montgomery called Gandhi's non-cooperation movement an anarchical movement in 1922.
So almost a hundred years later, what is happening is that you've got a government in place that is consistently using the language of the colonial masters.
Okay, I've heard you.
I've heard you.
I've heard you.
And the language has really not changed at all.
And my question is exactly that.
And the question that people on 1st of November will be asking is this.
There are 1,400 deletions in four booths.
I will keep coming back to that number because it's just four booths.
1,416 votes have been deleted.
Those people are standing right there saying we exist.
We are raising very serious questions about the election commission and about the
its own affidavit.
These questions, they deserve answers.
They do not deserve some stories about anarchy.
I take your point.
I will give Pranav a final word.
Pranav, as a lawyer turned CJP spokesperson, a final word according to Pradeep Bhatari who led the Supreme Court this time.
Allow me 10 seconds.
I want to remind the BJP of Article 19 sub clause 2 which says there can only be reasonable restriction on eight enumerated grounds.
None of these grounds relate to
the political proclivities of a potential influence.
Yes, there are reasonable restrictions, my dear friend.
Yesterday you had beaten up a policeman and even attempted to release them.
No, no, no.
Pradeep, you're being unfair.
How is this interference permitted?
No, no.
You tell me, will the RSS participation and listening and mandatory listening of Manki Baat also be forbidden under the UP civil services rule?
Then I will rest my case.
Let that be made very clear that anyone who is participating in a mandatory Manki Baat listening and RSS takat will not be eligible for government jobs in UP.
Let us end it there.
Secondly, we will have to ultimately run this government, this country by the edicts of the court and we have to justify.
Why has Jantar Mantar been denoted?
Why has Jantar Mantar been denoted?
Why has Jantar Mantar been denoted?
Why has Jantar Mantar been denoted?
Why has Jantar Mantar been denoted?
Why has Jantar Mantar been denoted?
Why has Jantar Mantar been denoted?
We must show courtesy to each other.
Y'all are younger people.
Pradeep Bandari, final word therefore to you.
Has Rahul Gandhi in the end again got under your skin?
Are you all rattled with Rahul Gandhi trying to make these speeches?
Or do you believe that you can handle Rahul Gandhi?
Your problem is more with these student protesters who don't affiliate themselves to any party.
Rajdeepji, the students of the country voted in Delhi University Student Union elections and the Congress got... 13%... 13%... No, no, no, no, man.
You cannot interview, sorry.
Let's not link it to that.
Let's not link it to that.
We have...
We are very, very happy with Rahul Gandhi protesting because the more Rahul Gandhi protests, the more votes of the BJP increase.
We have only problem with Rahul Gandhi's anarchy because last time when he protested, he was unpredicted.
We attempted to push some female policemen.
He did not follow the lines and my dear cockroaches, last time when you protested, there was attempt to lynch a policeman.
So please do
No, no, no.
You see Pradeep Bandhari selected you.
Pradeep Bandhari, there are examples of Hindu Rakshad Dal, members attacking protestors, peaceful protestors.
So let's not go.
You know, let's not be selective.
These are serious issues.
We can all use all kinds of videos.
Two wrongs don't make a right.
No, no, it's not about two wrongs don't make a right.
The fact is... It's a matter of investigation.
Okay, I'm going to leave it there.
I've heard all three of you.
I wonder though what the end game is.
So now you are saying the matter is of investigation.
I still wonder... No, no, when it is a matter of investigation, how can you have selective videos?
Okay, we've heard all three.
Okay, we've heard all three.
Put the faders down, producer.

and you can see them all holding very strongly to their positions.
Hopefully, one day we can get them to dialogue with each other rather than talk at each other.
